arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent animation sprite correction
Input images: Image 1 is the current approved polished SMDATE6 020 sprite and is the edit target. Image 2 is the approved SMDATE6 018 mango-design consistency anchor. Image 3 is the original 020 action and component-boundary guide.
Primary request: Replace only the strange green leafy food bundle at the mermaid's mouth with the same single ripe mango shown in Image 2, now held in both hands and being bitten.
Mango continuity: match Image 2's compact oval shape, approximate scale, warm golden yellow-orange body, restrained red blush on the outer right side, small muted green patch near the top, tiny short stem at the right end, highlight treatment, bold black outline, and overall identity. The yellow-orange left end touches and enters her open eating mouth naturally. A small fresh bite indentation at the mouth contact is acceptable, but keep the fruit recognizable as the same mango. NO leaves, NO leafy bundle, NO second fruit, NO sliced fruit.
Style/medium: match the established polished late-1990s cartoon sprite, bold clean black outline, smooth cel shading and highlights.
Constraints: Change only the food object and the minimum finger and mouth contact needed for a natural bite. Preserve pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible Image 1's approved mermaid identity, both visible squinting eyes, open eating mouth with teeth, forward lean, head angle, face, hair, cyan headband, green swimsuit, exposed bellybutton and torso, tail/waterline, both arm positions, both hands, crop, proportions, line weight, colors, and genuine transparent RGBA background. Do not turn the bite into a smile. No scenery, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.
